name: Iwamura Castle
description: Iwamura Castle, on a 720 m peak, is one of Japan's 'three great mountain castles'. It is also famed as the castle ruled by Lady Otsu no kata, wife of the warlord Oda Nobunaga; stone walls and the castle town remain.
highlights: One of the three great mountain castles
notes: Free open-air site; steep climb from the Iwamura Castle Town (a preserved district).
